systemState.current_training_focus: House #1: 2-Story Tampa Residence (Zone 1A 160 MPH Wind Load)

components.assembly: 6" Monolithic Post-Tensioned Concrete Slab over 15 mil Stego Wrap Vapor Barrier & 4" Clean Gravel

whySelected.reason: Post-tensioned monolithic slab resists soil settlement on sandy coastal Florida soil.
whySelected.environmentalFactor: Groundwater table at 4.5 ft requires 15 mil heavy vapor barrier to eliminate capillary moisture drive.
whySelected.codeRule: Florida Building Code Section 1808 shallow foundation requirements.
alternativesConsidered: Stem wall with raised wood floor
whySelected.costImpact: Saves 18% cost vs deep piling while maintaining structural load integrity.
whySelected.lifecycleNotes: Zero corrosion risk when post-tension tendons are grease-encapsulated.

components.assembly: 8" CMU Block Masonry + Rebar Reinforced Cells @ 24" o.c. + Stucco + 5/8" Type-X Gypsum

whySelected.reason: Grouted CMU masonry delivers wind resistance against 160 MPH hurricane projectiles in Tampa Bay.
whySelected.environmentalFactor: Salt spray & high humidity destroy unprotected wood exterior framing at ground level.
whySelected.codeRule: Florida Building Code 2023 Section 1609 Wind Load (Non-HVHZ Risk Category II).
whySelected.costImpact: Optimal local labor availability in Florida mason market.
whySelected.lifecycleNotes: 50+ year structural lifespan with zero rot risk.

components.assembly: Engineered Wood Hip Truss @ 24" o.c. + 5/8" CDX Deck + Self-Adhered Secondary Water Barrier + 24-Ga Galvalume Standing Seam Metal Panels

whySelected.reason: Hip roof geometry offers maximum aerodynamic resistance against hurricane wind uplift forces.
whySelected.environmentalFactor: Galvalume coating resists salt air corrosion superior to standard galvanized steel.
whySelected.codeRule: Florida Building Code Section 1507 metal roof uplift load test compliance.
whySelected.costImpact: 2.2x cost of asphalt shingle, offset by insurance discount and 40-year durability.
whySelected.lifecycleNotes: Reflects 70% solar radiation, drastically lowering A/C electrical consumption.

components.assembly: 3" Schedule 40 PVC Sanitary Waste Stack connecting to Main Sewer Line
components.inspectionNotes: Verified 1/4" per foot slope on 3" sanitary line.

whySelected.reason: Schedule 40 PVC provides smooth flow hydraulics and chemical resistance for sanitary waste.
whySelected.environmentalFactor: Non-corrosive material impervious to ground soil acidity.
whySelected.codeRule: Florida Plumbing Code Section 704.1 slope requirements.
whySelected.lifecycleNotes: Solvent welded joints guarantee zero leak integrity when installed at correct slope.

components.assembly: 200A 120/240V 42-Space Main Breaker Distribution Panel + Surge Protective Device (SPD)

whySelected.reason: Centralized 200A panel with surge protection defends sensitive household electronics against Florida lightning surges.
whySelected.environmentalFactor: Tampa area ranks #1 in U.S. for cloud-to-ground lightning strikes per square mile.
whySelected.codeRule: NEC 2023 Section 242.50 mandatory surge protection for dwelling units.
whySelected.costImpact: Protects thousands of dollars in connected home equipment.
whySelected.lifecycleNotes: SPD status LED provides instant operational confirmation.

inspectionTickets.problem: Insufficient modeled sanitary pipe slope. Measured at 1/8" per foot.
inspectionTickets.requiredStandard: Florida Plumbing Code Section 704.1 requires minimum 1/4" per foot slope for 3" diameter pipe.
inspectionTickets.actualCondition: Pipe modeled horizontally with only 0.125 in/ft fall.
inspectionTickets.proposedRepair: Adjust pipe hanger elevation drop by 0.5 inches over 20ft run to achieve 0.25 in/ft slope.

inspectionTickets.problem: Slab top elevation is 10.5 ft NAVD88; Flood Zone AE Base Flood Elevation is 11.0 ft NAVD88.
inspectionTickets.requiredStandard: ASCE 24-14 / Florida Building Code requires Finished Floor Elevation minimum +1 ft above BFE (12.0 ft).
inspectionTickets.actualCondition: Building finished floor modeled 1.5 ft below mandatory flood elevation line.
inspectionTickets.proposedRepair: Add 18" engineered compacted fill soil pad under slab to raise finished floor elevation to +12.5 ft NAVD88.

inspectionTickets.location: Roof Truss to Wall Plate Tie-Down Fasteners
inspectionTickets.problem: Truss hurricane clip fastener spec lists electro-galvanized nails.
inspectionTickets.requiredStandard: FBC HVHZ Section 2319 requires Hot-Dip Galvanized or Stainless Steel 316 clips within 2 miles of saltwater coast.
inspectionTickets.actualCondition: Electro-galvanized fasteners specified, prone to premature salt air rust.
inspectionTickets.proposedRepair: Update fastener schedule to Simpson Strong-Tie HDG / SS316 Hurricane Straps with SS ring-shank nails.

changeOrderRisks.issue: Sanitary pipe slope deficiency (PIPE-2-045) will cause sewer backup if uncorrected.
changeOrderRisks.recommendedMitigation: Execute Repair Swarm action to drop hanger brackets 0.5" before drywall enclosing.

changeOrderRisks.issue: Slab finished floor elevation below mandatory Base Flood Elevation line.
changeOrderRisks.recommendedMitigation: Add 18" compacted structural fill pad under slab to reach +12.5 ft NAVD88 elevation.

changeOrderRisks.issue: Roof truss hurricane clip fastener corrosion near salt water.
changeOrderRisks.recommendedMitigation: Swap electro-galvanized fasteners to 316 Stainless Steel prior to inspection sign-off.

knowledgeEntities.name: High-Velocity Hurricane Zone (HVHZ) Fastener Corrosion Protection

properties.provenance: FEMA Coastal Construction Manual & FBC HVHZ Section 2319
properties.sourceEvidence: Field failure studies show electro-galvanized nails fail within 7 years due to salt aerosol degradation.

knowledgeEntities.name: Continuous Sanitary Stack Gravity Drainage Slope Validation

properties.provenance: IPC International Plumbing Code Section 704 & Florida Plumbing Code
properties.sourceEvidence: Mandatory 1/4" per foot minimum slope prevents solid waste settling and sewer gas entrapment.

knowledgeEntities.name: Air-Entrained Concrete for Cold Climate Freeze-Thaw Resistance

properties.provenance: ACI 318 Exposure Class F2 & ASTM C260
properties.sourceEvidence: Microscopic air voids (4.5% - 7.5%) allow expanding frozen water relief without micro-cracking matrix.

learnedLessons.whatWorked: Verified continuous load path & 3D BIM integration for Tampa 2-Story Residence under FBC 2023 Non-HVHZ wind load.
learnedLessons.whatFailed: Initial anchor bolt spacing flagged; corrected via Grade 316 Stainless Steel bolts @ 24" o.c. (U = 0.224).
learnedLessons.nextGymObjective: Phase 3.1 Technical Validation Gate Active: Holding curriculum at Level 3.

learnedLessons.whatWorked: Monolithic post-tensioned slab eliminated differential soil settlement on soft coastal sand.
learnedLessons.whatFailed: Initial pipe modeling allowed 1/8" per foot slope on 3" sanitary line, failing plumbing inspection.
learnedLessons.whatRequiredRepair: Lowered sanitary pipe hangers 0.5" over 20ft run to achieve required 0.25 in/ft slope.
learnedLessons.nextGymObjective: Train on multi-story post-tensioned concrete elevated deck shoring sequencing.
